title: Nav2 controller server: progress and goal checking
keywords: nav2 controller server controller_frequency progress checker goal checker xy_goal_tolerance yaw_goal_tolerance failed to make progress stops short goal
text: The Nav2 controller server runs the local controller at controller_frequency (20 Hz by default) and uses two plugins: a progress checker aborts the goal when the robot does not move required_movement_radius within movement_time_allowance ("failed to make progress"), and a goal checker decides arrival from xy_goal_tolerance and yaw_goal_tolerance (stateful keeps the position satisfied once reached while the robot turns). A robot that stops short of the goal or keeps turning at the end usually has tolerances tighter than its localization accuracy. min_x_velocity_threshold treats tiny odometry speeds as zero.
